visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use .rm-glass for floating nav/headers (blur 24px, saturate 140%, bg white/4) and .rm-glass-strong for modals/dialogs. NEVER use complete transparent backgrounds under content.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Not applicable for this dark premium theme. Rely on 1px crisp borders, surface contrast, and subtle glowing shadows.
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: For the Permission Matrix: Use border-collapse with subtle right/bottom borders (border-white/10) to create a technical, dense layout.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid full-screen gradients. Use the existing .rm-mesh background for body. Use .rm-gradient-text exclusively for high-tier role names or empty state highlights.

components.sidebar: Custom Collapsible Sidebar. Desktop: framer-motion width transition (280px to 80px rail). Mobile: Shadcn `Sheet` component (left side).
components.permission_matrix: Shadcn `Table` or custom CSS Grid with `Accordion` for Tab -> Subtab -> Action hierarchy. Use Shadcn `Switch` or `Checkbox` for toggles.
components.drag_and_drop: Use `@dnd-kit/core` and `@dnd-kit/sortable` for the navigation ordering UI.
components.inputs: Shadcn `Input` customized with `.rm-input`. Use Shadcn `Select` for role picking and language ID/EN toggle.
components.toasts: Use `sonner` for all success/error feedback (e.g., 'Role Updated', 'Navigation Saved').

layouts.general: High-density grid for settings and matrices (gap-4 or gap-6). Use optical alignment. Containers must have padding (p-6 or p-8) if they have borders.
layouts.sidebar_layout: CSS Grid or Flex layout holding the Sidebar and Main Content. Main content must adjust smoothly when sidebar collapses.
layouts.matrix_layout: Sticky headers for the permission matrix columns so context isn't lost on scroll. Fixed width for feature names, fluid width for role checkboxes.

motion.sidebar_collapse: Framer motion transition on width: `type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 30`.
motion.drag_state: When dragging a subtab, scale it up slightly (`scale: 1.02`), add a strong magenta shadow (`shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,31,142,0.4)]`), and dim the rest of the list.
motion.hover_states: All interactive rows must have a subtle background shift (`hover:bg-white/5`) and explicitly defined text color (`hover:text-white`).

accessibility.testing_ids: Every interactive and key informational element MUST have a `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="sidebar-toggle-btn"`, `data-testid="role-matrix-switch"`).
accessibility.focus_states: Focus states must use `#FF1F8E` ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF1F8E]/50`).
accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap Framer Motion configurations to respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

media.images_constraints: Use `max-h-[80vh]` on mobile for any modal images. Maintain aspect ratios.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this data-heavy admin panel. Focus on 2D DOM performance for the heavy permission matrix and drag-and-drop interactions.

image_urls.description: Music producer in dark studio. Use for empty states, onboarding modals, or the UI settings header banner to reinforce the premium music brand.

sidebar_navigation.desktop: Collapsible to icon rail (80px). Only icons and tooltips remain visible. Expand to 280px for full text.
sidebar_navigation.mobile: Hidden by default. Accessed via Hamburger menu opening a left-anchored `Sheet` (drawer).
sidebar_navigation.active_state: Active tabs must have a left-border indicator (2px solid #FF1F8E) and a very subtle gradient background (`bg-gradient-to-r from-[#FF1F8E]/10 to-transparent`).

role_management.creation: Button `data-testid="create-role-btn"` opens a Dialog to input custom role name.
role_management.matrix_ui: A dense grid where rows are grouped by Tab -> Subtab -> Action. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide (ChevronRight/Down) to expand/collapse groups. Use indeterminate states for parent checkboxes if only some children are selected.

ui_admin_role.language_dictionary: A two-column grid (Indonesian | English) for navigation labels. Inline editable inputs customized with .rm-input.
ui_admin_role.drag_and_drop_nav: A list of existing internal routes. Users can drag items to reorder them, or drag them under a 'Subtab Group' node to nest them. Visually represent nesting with indentation (pl-8) and tree-lines (border-l). Use @dnd-kit/core.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that fit the 'dark premium RILIS MUSIK' aesthetic. Use the existing CSS variables (.rm-mesh, .rm-glass, .rm-card, etc.).
NEVER apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
NEVER center align the app container. Use proper layout grids.
Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react for sharp, technical dashboard icons.
Layered design: use z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (.rm-glass) to create depth over the .rm-mesh background.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance staggered animations (.rm-stagger).
Missing categories/images must not be filled with text placeholders. Use provided image URLs or stylised empty state UI.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use solid surfaces or strong glass (.rm-glass-strong).

instructions_to_main_agent.files_extension: Use .js or .jsx extensions for all React components. Do not use .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Implement the Layout wrapper. Build the Sidebar component utilizing framer-motion for width collapse on desktop (280px to 80px), and Shadcn Sheet for mobile. Map existing CSS variables.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Build the Role Management view. Create the Tabs for 'Permissions' and 'UI Settings'.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Implement the Permission Matrix inside the Permissions tab. Build a recursive accordion-style table/grid for Tabs > Subtabs > Actions.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the UI Settings tab. Add a section for bilingual dictionary inputs (ID/EN) and a section for Navigation Ordering using @dnd-kit/core and @dnd-kit/sortable.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes. Apply .rm-glass and .rm-mesh aesthetics to panels and backgrounds.
